GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2020-03-19T08:25:50Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: doOnSubscribe don't work as expected.
Description: RxJava 2.2.19
My code(sample):
```
class Foo {

	private val someCachedData = listOf(1, 2, 3)

	private val publisher = PublishProcessor.create<Int>()

	fun getPublisher(): Flowable<Int> = publisher.onBackpressureBuffer().publish().refCount()

	fun subscribe() {
		println("subscribe called")

		someCachedData.forEach(publisher::onNext)
	}
 }

 fun main() {

	val foo = Foo()

	foo.getPublisher()
		.subscribeOn(Schedulers.computation())
		.doOnSubscribe {
			println("doOnSubscribe called")
			foo.subscribe()
		}
		.subscribe { print(it) }

	Thread.sleep(10000)
}
```

Output:
```
doOnSubscribe called
subscribe called

Process finished with exit code 0
```
If i add some delay to call `foo.subscribe()`, App works fine.
The following code works fine:
```
foo.getPublisher()
		.subscribeOn(Schedulers.computation())
		.doOnSubscribe {
			println("doOnSubscribe called")
			Single.just(true)
				.subscribeOn(Schedulers.single())
				.delay(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
				.subscribe { _ ->
					foo.subscribe()
				}
		}
		.subscribe { print(it) }
```
